name: Boundary Conditions for Wavelet Transform on Intervals
aliases: Handling Finite Datasets in Wavelet Transforms
definition: Spatial windowing handles finite datasets by extending the function $f(x)$ to $\tilde{f}(x)$ where $\tilde{f}(x) = f(x)$ for $x \in [0, 1]$ and 0 otherwise. This causes discontinuities at $f(0)$ and $f(1)$, leading to high frequency bursts and extending the number of relevant basis functions by $2^{-m}$.
summary: Boundary conditions for wavelet transforms on intervals extend finite datasets to the real line using strategies like reflection or repetition to prevent artificial discontinuities and control basis function counts.
